name: install
wording: per agent harness at one installation scope: user, across every project, by default, or project, inside one project and shared through it; under that scope's owned root, recording the projecting version; idempotent; within a project its project installation takes precedence over the user's; offers the corpus's rulesets, each taken whole, rule by rule or not at all; asks only what it isn't told, never choosing a tier's model in the operator's place: a user installation asks for each tier's model and names each left unbound as the operator's next step, while a project installation binds none, a model being each operator's own setting
reason: A project installation is shared through the project, and a tier's model is each operator's own setting, so binding one in the shared project would impose one operator's models on the team.
